name: Home
description: An interactive treemap site. Tap any tile to explore.

children.name: About This Site
children.description: Learn what TreeSite is and how to navigate it.
children.title: About This Site

children.name: What Is TreeSite?
children.description: TreeSite is a spatial website: the whole site is one zoomable treemap. Sections and pages are tiles you can tap to drill in.
children.title: What Is TreeSite?

children.name: How It Works
children.description: Content lives in a portable artifact bundle (JSON items + assets). The handler loads manifest.json at runtime—no rebuild required to swap sites.
children.title: How It Works

children.name: Content Types
children.description: Sample cards for each supported tile type.
children.title: Content Types

children.name: Nested Section
children.description: Section tiles group related cards. Tap to zoom into their subtree.
children.title: Nested Section

children.name: Nested Item
children.description: Items can live under nested section paths. The section field uses slash-separated paths.
children.title: Nested Item

children.name: Text Card
children.description: Plain text tiles show a title and description. They are the simplest content type.
children.title: Text Card

children.name: Website Card
children.description: Website tiles link to external URLs. Previews appear when a screenshot asset is bundled.
children.title: Website Card

children.name: Navigation
children.description: How to move around the treemap interface.
children.title: Navigation

children.name: Tap to Zoom
children.description: Click or tap a tile to focus that section. The treemap re-layouts to show its children.
children.title: Tap to Zoom

children.name: Breadcrumbs
children.description: Use breadcrumbs or the back control to return to a parent section without losing context.
children.title: Breadcrumbs

children.name: Mini Map
children.description: The mini map shows the full site hierarchy so you can jump between top-level sections quickly.
children.title: Mini Map
